tasks.listening-speaking-t1: Topic: Listening and Speaking. Cover greetings, introductions, family vocabulary, classroom language, and simple oral questions. Ask learners to choose polite responses, complete short dialogue turns, identify correct oral phrases about family or school, and apply clear pronunciation and turn-taking.
tasks.reading-viewing-t1: Topic: Reading and Viewing. Cover short dialogues, labels, notices, familiar vocabulary, and picture clues. Ask learners to match words to images, read for key details, answer who/where/what comprehension items, and complete true-or-false checks from simple texts.
tasks.writing-presenting-t1: Topic: Writing and Presenting. Cover simple sentences, personal details, family paragraph writing, captions, and short lists. Ask learners to order sentences logically, choose correct written forms, fill in personal information, and identify clear ways to present written information orally.
tasks.language-structures-t1: Topic: Language Structures and Conventions. Cover personal pronouns, subject concords, singular and plural forms, present tense, and punctuation. Ask learners to complete grammar gap-fills, choose correct sentence forms, edit punctuation errors, and match concords to subjects in simple contexts.
